title: Stone Separator
keywords: Separates configured stone, wood and other basic materials into useful products

blocks.text: Separates configured stone, wood and other basic materials into useful products. One input can produce multiple outputs.

rows: Choose a live Stone Separator recipe.
Supply its exact ingredient and full batch energy.
Reserve space for every output, including secondary products such as sticks or shards.

blocks.text: An empty secondary output destination can matter as much as the primary one; check all pending results.
